info.title: C2C Merchant API
info.description: API for merchants to create payment orders, check order status, and query balance on the C2C Platform.

bearerAuth.description: Your merchant API key in the format `mk_live_xxxx`. Pass it as a Bearer token.

SignatureTimestampHeader.name: X-C2C-Timestamp
SignatureTimestampHeader.description: Unix epoch seconds used to build the request signature. See the [Request Signing](/signing) guide. Requests more than 5 minutes out of sync with the server clock are rejected.

SignatureSignatureHeader.name: X-C2C-Signature
SignatureSignatureHeader.description:
`sha256=<hex>` — HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical request string (`timestamp
METHOD
path
hex(sha256(body))`), keyed with your signing secret. On `POST` requests each signature is accepted only once — re-sign every retry with a fresh timestamp or it is rejected as `SIGNATURE_REPLAYED`. See the [Request Signing](/signing) guide.

amount.description: Order amount in PKR. Must be a positive value within your configured pay/draw limits.

currency.description: Currency code. Currently only PKR is supported.

walletType.description: The wallet type the customer will use to send or receive money. Required — the platform selects an available member who has an approved account of this wallet type.

merchantOrderRef.description: Your own reference number for this order (e.g. your internal order ID). Returned in status responses and webhook payloads.

customerAccountNumber.description: **Required for Withdrawal orders.** The customer's wallet account number that the assigned member will send money to.

customerReference.description: Your internal customer identifier for reference and filtering.

callbackUrl.description: Absolute `http://` or `https://` URL (HTTPS recommended) that receives a webhook POST when the order completes or fails. Webhooks are signed with your API key's signing secret. Any other scheme is rejected with `400`. See the [Webhooks guide](/webhooks) for payload shapes and signature verification.

successUrl.description: Absolute `http://` or `https://` URL the payment page sends the customer to, 5 seconds after the order is `Completed`/`Confirmed`, with `c2c_order_id`, `c2c_order_reference` and `c2c_status` query parameters appended. Any other scheme is rejected with `400`. The redirect is not proof of payment — confirm via webhook or the status endpoint before fulfilling. If omitted, the payment page shows a generic success screen.

failureUrl.description: Absolute `http://` or `https://` URL the payment page sends the customer to, 5 seconds after the order is rejected, cancelled or expires, with `c2c_order_id`, `c2c_order_reference` and `c2c_status` query parameters appended. Any other scheme is rejected with `400`. If omitted, the payment page shows a generic failure screen.

metadata.description: Arbitrary string (e.g. JSON) you can attach to the order for your own reference. Not displayed to customers or members.

txnRefDigitsRequired.description: Number of trailing digits from the wallet transaction ID that the customer must enter on the payment page. Allowed range: 4–8. Defaults to 4.

maxRetryCount.description: Maximum number of times the customer can re-submit a transaction reference after a member rejection. When retries are exhausted the order moves to ManualReview. Allowed range: 0–10. Defaults to 3.

orderId.description: Unique order identifier. Use this to poll status or in webhook matching.

paymentPageUrl.description: Signed URL to redirect your customer to. The payment page displays the assigned member's account number and collects the customer's transaction reference. Expires at `expiresAt`.

status.description: Initial status. Newly created deposit orders start as `Queued`; withdrawal orders start as `AwaitingMemberPayout`.

expiresAt.description: UTC timestamp when the payment page URL expires (15 minutes from creation). After this time the order moves to `Expired` if the customer has not submitted a transaction reference.

status.description: Current status of the order. See the status lifecycle table in the server integration guide.

queuedAt.description: When the order entered the queue (UTC).

confirmedAt.description: When the order was confirmed (UTC). Null if not yet confirmed.

cancelledAt.description: When the order was cancelled (UTC). Null for non-cancelled orders.

frozenBalance.description: Balance temporarily frozen due to pending orders.

tags.name: Order Status
tags.description: Check the status of a payment order

post.description:
Creates a new payment order. The platform automatically selects an eligible online member whose account matches the requested `walletType`. Returns a signed payment page URL to redirect your customer to — the page displays the assigned member's account number and collects the customer's last-4-digit transaction reference.

**Deposit orders**: The customer sends money to the displayed account, then submits the last 4 digits of their transaction ID (and optionally a receipt image) on the payment page. The assigned member then verifies and approves or rejects the order.

**Withdrawal orders**: The assigned member sends money to `customerAccountNumber`, then confirms with the last 4 digits of their outbound transaction.

**Withdrawal funding**: your available balance must cover the new withdrawal plus all withdrawals still in progress (amount + fee each), otherwise the request is rejected with `422` and no order is created.

**Important**: You must include the `Idempotency-Key` header to prevent duplicate orders, and sign every request — see [Request Signing](/signing). Re-sign each retry with a fresh timestamp (keep the same `Idempotency-Key`). The `walletType` field is required.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this order, scoped to your API key. If you retry with the same key — including concurrent retries — the original order is returned with its current status and no duplicate is created. Keys do not expire; use a new key for every new order. See [Idempotency](/idempotency).

deposit.summary: Deposit order (customer sends to member account)

withdrawal.summary: Withdrawal order (member sends to customer account)

200.description: Order created — or, for an `Idempotency-Key` already used by this API key, the original order with its current status

400.description: Invalid request (e.g. a `callbackUrl`/`successUrl`/`failureUrl` that is not an absolute http(s) URL) or missing Idempotency-Key

invalidUrl.summary: Redirect or callback URL is not http(s)

value.error: SuccessUrl must be a valid absolute http(s) URL.

401.description: Missing/invalid API key (`UNAUTHORIZED`), missing/expired/invalid request signature (`SIGNATURE_REQUIRED`, `SIGNATURE_EXPIRED`, `SIGNATURE_INVALID`), or a signature that was already used (`SIGNATURE_REPLAYED`) — see [Request Signing](/signing)

invalidSignature.summary: Missing, expired, or invalid request signature

value.error: Request signature is missing, expired, or invalid.

replayedSignature.summary: Same signed request sent twice — re-sign retries with a fresh timestamp

value.error: Request signature is missing, expired, or invalid.

422.description: No eligible member available for this wallet type and amount, or (withdrawals only) insufficient merchant balance to cover this withdrawal plus withdrawals in progress, including fees

value.error: No eligible member is currently available for this order.
Insufficient merchant balance: 1200.00 PKR available, 2060.00 PKR required for this withdrawal and withdrawals in progress (including fees).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — 100 requests/minute per API key. Empty response body; wait for the 60-second window to reset. See [Rate Limits](/rate-limits).

get.description:
Returns the current status of an order. Poll this endpoint every 3–5 seconds after creating an order to detect when it is confirmed or rejected.

**Status values**:
- `Pending` — waiting for the customer to submit their transaction reference on the payment page
- `Confirmed` — the assigned member verified receipt of funds and approved the order
- `Rejected` — the assigned member did not receive the payment and rejected the order; prompt the customer to retry
- `Expired` — the order timed out without confirmation

This request must be signed — see [Request Signing](/signing).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The `orderId` returned when you created the order.

401.description: Missing/invalid API key (`UNAUTHORIZED`), or missing/expired/invalid request signature (`SIGNATURE_REQUIRED`, `SIGNATURE_EXPIRED`, `SIGNATURE_INVALID`) — see [Request Signing](/signing)

404.description: Order not found or does not belong to this API key

get.description:
Returns the current platform balance associated with your API key, including any frozen amount from pending orders.

This request must be signed — see [Request Signing](/signing).
